items.title: Restore and enforce browser-only Playwright discovery
items.why: Browser coverage cannot start while the browser runner imports Node-only ESM suites. Missing auth currently tolerates the failing full-suite step.
items.recipe: Exclude Node unit specs for both JavaScript module extensions in every Playwright project, prove actual collection contains browser tests and no unit suites, and make discovery a mandatory CI prerequisite independent of authentication secrets.
items.acceptance: Actual Chromium/Firefox/WebKit inventories contain browser tests and zero Node unit specs; negative fixture proves newly added .mjs unit tests cannot execute in browser discovery; mandatory workflow collection runs without credentials; node unit and full build checks pass; exact candidate staging/hosted checks and production readback.
